title: Department of Homeland Security: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
publisher: Department of Homeland Security Office of Inspector General
summary: DHS OIG's official project record identifies the FY 2025 enterprise review but does not expose the completed annual result. Phase 56F decision: The review identity is known, but the required annual outcome cannot be closed from a project-status record.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Released FY 2025 enterprise FISMA result.
